hook.line: You've been saying *Que descanses* as a whole phrase for a while. Colombians also say just *Descansa*. It's the same wish in two shapes, and neither one is more polite.
hook.es: Que descanses, mañana es un día largo.
hook.en: Rest well, tomorrow is a long day. (to a friend)

examples.en: Enjoy yourselves at the party. (you all)

rule:
Shape one: *que* plus the wish form, the end of *espero que* with the front cut off. *Que te diviertas.* *Que descanses.* The little word goes before the verb.

Shape two: the command form, with the little word stuck on the end. *Diviértete.* *Descansa.* *Mejórate.*

Same meaning, same warmth. Pick whichever comes out first.

For *usted*: *Que se mejore* or *Mejórese*. For a group: *Que se diviertan* or *Diviértanse*.

Don't mix the two: *que* always comes with the wish form.

options: Enjoy yourself at the party. (to a friend)
Enjoy yourselves at the party. (you all)
I hope I get better soon.
Get some rest, you deserve it. (to a friend)

yourTurn.prompt: Pick *diviertes* or *diviertas* and type the whole wish, to a friend: *Que te ___ en Cartagena.*
Pick *Descansa* or *Descansas* and type the whole line, to a friend: *___, te lo mereces.*
yourTurn.why: Without *que* it's the command shape, so *Descansa*.

yourTurn.prompt: Say to a friend, with the *que* shape: Get well soon.
Say to don Hernando (formal), with the *que* shape: Get well soon.
yourTurn.why: For *usted*, *te* becomes *se* and the *s* at the end goes.

yourTurn.prompt: Say the same wish in the other shape: *Que te diviertas.*
yourTurn.why: In the command shape, *te* goes on the end: *Diviértete*.

yourTurn.prompt: Say the same wish in the other shape: *Disfruta el viaje.*
Make it for a group (you all): *Que te diviertas en la fiesta.*
yourTurn.answer: Que se diviertan en la fiesta.
yourTurn.why: For *ustedes*, *te* becomes *se* and the verb ends in *n*.

pitfalls.why: Almost. After *que*, a wish takes the wish form: *diviertas*.
Without *que* the wish falls apart; say *Que te diviertas* or *Diviértete*.
Pick one shape: *Diviértete* on its own, or *Que te diviertas*.

personal: Think of someone you'll see this week. Write the wish you'll give them, in both shapes (*Que descanses* and *Descansa*, or *Que te diviertas* and *Diviértete*).
